_ground: 2026-08-05 static read. 21 .channel( subscriptions - the most of any page. 4 edge fns. Role-gated supervisor actions. The verdict on this page is the realtime lifecycle across hive switches.

invariants.name: all 21 subscriptions re-key on hive switch
invariants.oracle: every realtime subscription is torn down on hive switch and re-opened against the new hive - a surviving channel is a cross-tenant leak with a live wire, not a stale render

invariants.name: getChannels() has no duplicate topic after switch-return
invariants.oracle: after switching away and back, getChannels() returns no duplicate topic - the listener-lifecycle class

invariants.name: supervisor actions refused at the edge fn
invariants.oracle: a supervisor-only action is refused AT THE SERVER for a worker token, not merely hidden in the UI

invariants.name: membership mutations leave attributed audit rows
invariants.oracle: every hive_audit_log write names its actor from the JWT, and no board action that mutates membership completes without one

invariants.name: network benchmarks expose no foreign hive row
invariants.oracle: the page never shows another hive's identifiable row - the network figure is aggregate-only, proven from the payload rather than the label

invariants.name: readiness is reproducible
invariants.oracle: the readiness score is reproducible: same inputs, same score, across a reload and a realtime-driven repaint

domain_truths.name: readiness states its inputs and weights
domain_truths.oracle: the readiness composite states its inputs and weights on the surface - a 67/100 nobody can decompose is a vibe with a number attached

domain_truths.name: PM-overdue and PM-compliance cannot disagree
domain_truths.oracle: PM-overdue count and PM-compliance % on the same board derive from one denominator and cannot disagree

domain_truths.name: a fresh badge names its threshold
domain_truths.oracle: a 'fresh' badge names the age threshold it passed

domain_truths.name: MTBF/MTTR match analytics under ISO 14224
domain_truths.oracle: MTBF/MTTR on the board follow ISO 14224 definitions and match analytics to the same decimal

domain_truths.name: board XP equals achievements

domain_truths.name: low-stock equals inventory's reorder predicate

domain_truths.name: benchmarks state cohort and n
domain_truths.oracle: the benchmark panel states whether the cohort is network-wide or same-industry, and the cohort's n - a percentile against 3 hives is not a benchmark
